title: PressureIQ: A Quantitative Framework for Evaluating Cricket Performance Under Pressure

pressure_definition.chasing_model: Non-linear sigmoidal acceleration curve based on Required Run Rate (RRR), wickets lost, and deliveries remaining.
pressure_definition.first_innings_model: Dynamic par-score reference curve contrasting Current Run Rate (CRR) against venue par scores with wickets decay.
pressure_definition.separation: Batting pressure and bowling pressure are independently evaluated based on cognitive and strategic match leverage.

quality_and_resilience.description: Retention of performance under pressure vs. normal baseline (BPPI / BPPI-B)

absolute_performance.description: Raw clutch output (HP Strike Rate, HP Boundary %, HP Economy Rate)

pressure_context.description: Exposure to extreme pressure (P ≥ 75) and match importance weight

formulas.name: Final Batter Pressure Rating (FBPR)
formulas.description: Multi-dimensional composite rating evaluating clutch batting resilience and execution.

formulas.name: Final Bowler Pressure Rating (FBOR)
formulas.description: Multi-dimensional composite rating evaluating death/clutch bowling economy and wicket-taking.

formulas.name: Empirical Bayes Shrinkage
formulas.description: James-Stein shrinkage towards global prior means to prevent small-sample distortion.

formulas.name: Required Run Rate Leverage
formulas.description: Pre-delivery chasing demand formulation for second-innings pressure dynamics.

eligibility_thresholds.batting: Minimum 40 balls faced under high pressure (P ≥ 60) across at least 4 matches
eligibility_thresholds.bowling: Minimum 48 legal deliveries (8.0 overs) bowled under high pressure (P ≥ 60) across at least 4 matches
